messages:
erika_partnerships: Quick Q2 sync — we're launching the SI joint-play wave next week (marketplace + co-sell). Need a compact intake + ownership rule set we can push to partners. Thinking: 24h claim window for SI to accept a lead, 72h fallback to Sales if unclaimed. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria_md: Ack. I'll paste the draft confluence section in a sec: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Partner/pages/si-orbit-intake

sam_sales: 24h is tight for some partners, esp. EMEA. Can we do 48h for claim, 72h final? Also: require `demo-ready` flag to be true before SI claim unless partner is certified.

jordan_pm: +1 to demo-ready gating. Can we do a canary: small set of 'certified' partners with 24h, everyone else 48h? Test for two weeks.

ashok_eng: For dedupe/mapping: recommend matching by canonical domain + fuzzy company name (levenshtein <= 2) + industry. Pseudocode:
```
SELECT * FROM leads
WHERE normalize(domain) = normalize(incoming.domain)
OR similarity(normalize(name), normalize(incoming.name)) > 0.85
```
Flag duplicates as `si_conflict` and push to a small adjudication queue.

leo_engineer: For webhook + integration: we'll need `partner_id`, `partner_cert_level`, `claim_by`, `demo_ready` on the payload. Also add `source = 'marketplace' | 'direct' | 'si'` so routing works. I'll post sample webhook tomorrow.

erika_partnerships: Draft playbook (short):
- Intake tag set: `source=si_orbit`, `partner_id=<id>`, `partner_cert=<bronze|silver|gold>`
- Claim window: certified partners = 24h, others = 48h
- If unclaimed after 72h => auto-assign to local AE queue
- Duplicate detection => `si_conflict` label; manual adjudication by partner ops within 48h
- Demo-ready required unless partner has `cert_level=gold`
- Marketplace leads get priority routing to SI-enabled AEs

maria_md: I'll update the confluence with that playbook. Also adding an intake form for partners (short) and an opt-in checkbox for 'allow direct handoff'.

sam_sales: Need escalation path: if AE rejects a claimed lead, where does it go? propose fallback->regional BD leader, then back to partner ops.

erika_partnerships: Good call. Add step: `reject` => 24h regional BD review => partner ops adjudicate => either reassign or close. Put in SLA table.

jordan_pm: Let's measure: claim_time, time_to_first_contact, conversion rate by partner_cert. We'll run two-week canary and compare.

ashok_eng: Note: CRM enrichment jobs sometimes lag. Recommend we run dedupe + enrichment as part of intake pipeline and mark `enriched=false` until done so partners see consistent data.

leo_engineer: pinging @announce-bot to schedule a short 30m kickoff tomorrow 09:30 PT with tech + sales + partners folks.

announce-bot: Meeting created: SI Orbit Intake Kickoff — Tue 09:30 PT — calendar invites sent to @erika_partnerships @maria_md @sam_sales @jordan_pm @ashok_eng @leo_engineer

erika_partnerships: Thanks all — I'll own the confluence update and the SLA table. If no major objections by EOD we'll ship the partner-facing doc. :rocket:
